summary: Senior Java & MuleSoft Developer position available in Mumbai. The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-grade applications using Java 17+ and Spring Boot.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications using Java 17+ and Spring Boot.
Develop and manage MuleSoft integrations, ensuring smooth data flow across systems.
Implement and optimize TypeScript-based components for front-end or integration layers.
Work with Jules and Gaia Scheduler Framework for scheduling and orchestration of jobs.
required_skills: Strong proficiency in Java (17+), Spring Boot, and MuleSoft integration concepts (API-led connectivity).
Hands-on experience with RESTful API development.
Familiarity with Gaia Scheduler Framework and Jules for job scheduling.
Knowledge of microservices architecture and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
Good understanding of software development best practices and Agile methodologies.
qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
